subject: GetYourGuide day tours from London that include Windsor, grouped by what the day covers
source: data/day-trips/gyg-inventory.json (36 Windsor product ids) plus product pages opened one by one in the browser pane at https://www.getyourguide.com/en-gb/activity/-t<id>
method: 14 product pages opened and read on 12 September 2026. For each one the inclusions and exclusions rows were read off the page by their tick/cross icon, not from the title, so a line reading 'Entry to Windsor Castle (if option selected)' is recorded as conditional even though it sits in the INCLUDES list. Prices are the page's own adult 'from' price on the date checked; where the page showed a struck-through price both are recorded. Durations, departure points, ratings and review counts are the product page's own.

doorPriceBaseline.windsorCastleAdult: GBP 32.00 in advance, GBP 36.00 on the day (Royal Collection Trust)
doorPriceBaseline.trainFromLondon: GBP 7.90 off-peak contactless single from Paddington via Slough; GBP 8.90 from Waterloo direct

conditionalEntryPattern: The single trap on this destination. A product names Windsor Castle in its title, then its inclusions list carries the line 'Entry to Windsor Castle (if option selected)'. The headline 'from' price is the option WITHOUT the ticket, so a reader who books the cheapest option arrives at Windsor with no castle ticket and pays GBP 36 at the gate. Of the 14 pages read, 9 do this with the castle.

groups.verdict: The only group where the castle ticket is reliably in the price.
